lessons: STALE pin bumped: israeli-bank-scrapers 6.7.4 (2026-04-20) -> 6.7.8 (2026-06-15). Only point-release bug fixes since review (6.7.5 leumi, 6.7.6 yahav, 6.7.7 visa-cal, 6.7.8 discount), NO breaking change and NO CompanyTypes enum change. The >=6.7.x pin stays valid; just refresh the 'current release' figure each cycle.

VERIFIED OK (no change): no fabricated CLI (the package is library-only, bin:null) and the prior agorot/OAuth-class traps are absent; the CompanyTypes enum exactly matches the skill's 18 entries (14 banks + 4 card cos), BOI codes consistent, both MCP wrappers live.
Softened il-bank-mcp (glekner): noted it is less actively maintained (last push mid-2025) and pins an older scraper (6.1.4); israeli-bank-mcp (mottibec) is the more current wrapper.

Stripped pervasive PRE-EXISTING em-dashes from the touched files (SKILL.md, SKILL_HE.md, references/supported-banks.md): table-cell BOI 'no code' em-dash -> hyphen, prose ' - ' separators -> commas. The em-dash ban applies to every file touched in an update, not just edited lines.

PIN BUMPED 6.7.8 -> 6.9.0 (2026-07-22). 6.9.0 added Leumi savings accounts and Max credit-card balances, so an older pin silently returns LESS rather than failing. 6.8.0 completed the Visa Cal frame work; 6.7.9 fixed a Max login-page failure and 6.7.10 added an Isracard bot-detection workaround, so anything below 6.7.10 fails outright on those two providers.
CRITICAL FIXED: the categoriser counted pension/hishtalmut/gemel deposits as SPENDING. Total Spending, Into Savings and Total Outflow are now reported separately.

CRITICAL FIXED (my own fix was defeated by pattern order): the insurance patterns (harel/migdal/menora) sat BEFORE the savings patterns in a single first-match dict, so 'הפקדה לקרן פנסיה מגדל' classified as insurance and pension money went straight back into Total Spending. Savings now live in a PRIORITY_PATTERNS table tested first. Lesson: when a fix depends on which of two overlapping rules wins, test the collision case explicitly, not just the happy path.
CRITICAL FIXED: abs(amount) meant refunds, reversals and any incoming credit were counted as spending. Positive amounts are now tracked as credits and excluded from spending, with a Credits In line.
FIXED: percentages divided by the spending-only total while the category rows still included savings, so the column summed to well over one hundred. Now divides by Total Outflow and sums to ~100.

FIXED: Hebrew substring patterns matched inside longer words (פז fired on פזגז, הוט on מלון הוט, מגדל on קניון מגדל שלום). Added a leading Hebrew-letter guard plus explicit trailing guards on the whole-word tokens. NOTE: a blanket trailing guard broke the פנסי stem (it must still match פנסיה) - the guard is deliberately leading-only, with per-pattern trailing guards.
FIXED: category_count used `+= amount and 1`, so a zero-amount transaction was never counted and the counter became a float.
FIXED: top_merchants included savings, contradicting the documented 'top merchants by spending'.
FIXED: --example ignored --output-json, returning an unparseable table to any agent following the documented flag.
ADDED: a credentials and transaction-data handling section in both languages. This skill drives a scraper over live bank usernames, passwords and OTPs and had no handling rule at all.
FIXED: the frontmatter/metadata 'Supports ...' list named 12 banks while the reference said 14 (Behatsdaa and Beyahad Bishvilha were missing).
VERIFIED: CompanyTypes enum is 18 entries and references/supported-banks.md matches it exactly, including pagi.
carry: Keyword categorisation still mis-assigns genuinely ambiguous Hebrew names: קניון מגדל שלום (a mall) hits the insurer מגדל, and מלון הוט (a hotel) hits the cable company הוט. Documented as a limitation in both languages; a merchant-ID or MCC-based approach would be the real fix.

Unsourced claims still in the body: the Berlin Group NextGenPSD2 basis for Israeli Open Banking; the per-bank history-depth claim (Hapoalim/Leumi <12 months, FIBI group 12+); session lifetimes of ~15-30 minutes and OneZero's OTP setup; bank ownership/positioning notes (Yahav owned by Hapoalim, Massad education sector, Pagi Charedi-focused); and the il-bank-mcp last-push date and its 6.1.4 pin. Source or hedge each next cycle.
The phrase 'a substantial share' for typical Israeli payslip savings deductions is unsourced; either cite a BTL/pension figure or drop the quantifier.

lessons: PIN RE-VERIFIED, NOT CHANGED: 6.9.0 (2026-07-22) is still the latest published release on the npm registry as of 27 August 2026. Nothing shipped in five weeks. The 18-entry CompanyTypes enum was enumerated IN FULL from master and diffed row by row against references/supported-banks.md: zero discrepancies, pagi included.

NEW ROOT ANCHOR ADDED: israeli-bank-scrapers declares engines.node >= 22.22.2. The skill had never mentioned a Node floor, so a user on Node 20 got an install or run failure whose message never names a bank, and the skill offered no way to diagnose it.

CRITICAL REGRESSION FOUND AND FIXED, and it is the same defect v1.3.0 recorded as CRITICAL FIXED with a lesson attached about testing collisions. The leading Hebrew-letter lookbehind added in v1.3.0 cannot tell a prefix letter from a word letter, so it blocked the savings patterns on the most ordinary Hebrew phrasing: 'הפקדה לגמל מנורה' and 'ניכוי לפנסיה מגדל מקפת' both classified as INSURANCE, putting the pension deposit straight back into Total Spending, which is exactly the bug the guard was written to prevent. Only 'קרן פנסיה' survived, because a space precedes the token there. Fixed by matching against a de-prefixed copy of each Hebrew token rather than trying to express the rule in a lookbehind. The v1.3.0 lesson was right and was not followed: the collision was not re-tested after the guard changed.

CRITICAL: the Latin half of every pattern had NO boundary guard, and both SKILL files told the user the patterns were guarded and named only two residual ambiguities. Verified: 'Hotel Dan' and 'PHOTO SHOP' matched `hot` into Utilities, 'Omega Watches' matched `mega` into Groceries, 'Parent Teacher Assoc' matched `rent` into Housing, 'Pazzo Pizza' matched `paz` into Transportation. Latin letter guards added on both sides. The documentation claim was what made it critical: a user told the matching is boundary-safe does not audit those rows.
FIXED: 'חברת החשמל' and 'ועד הבית', the skill's OWN category-table examples, fell into Other because the patterns used `.?`, which cannot span the definite article's space plus ה. Now `\s*ה?\s*`.

FIXED: a string amount, which is what every bank CSV and Excel export produces and which SKILL.md Step 1 explicitly routes MCP-less users to, crashed with a bare TypeError. Now coerced, with a message naming the likely cause when it cannot be.

FIXED: the code comment said credits were 'netted against the category' and nothing netted them. Rather than silently change the semantics, the gross figures stay (a salary is not a negative grocery bill) and a net_by_category view was added to the JSON, with the comment corrected to match the code.
FIXED: the Credits In line was labelled 'refunds/reversals' while salary, transfers in and loan drawdowns all land there. An 18,000 salary printed as a refund. Relabelled.

FIXED: 'restaurants' and 'shopping' were declared categories no pattern could ever produce, while references/spending-categories.md put restaurants under Entertainment. Removed the two dead names and added restaurant and cafe patterns mapping to Entertainment, so the reference and the script now agree and a restaurant actually classifies.
FIXED: 'גמל' had no trailing guard, so 'גמלאות' (pension annuity INCOME) read as a deposit. Zero-amount lines no longer create an empty merchant row.

MCP ACCURACY, a whole class of gap the skill had never covered: neither server is installable with npx. israeli-bank-mcp is not on npm (registry 404, against a 404 negative control on a nonsense sibling) and declares no bin; it is clone, npm install, npm run build, then node build/server.js. il-bank-mcp is docker compose. Both install shapes are now stated, along with the fact that israeli-bank-mcp exposes exactly two tools and one resource and does no analysis at all.

SECURITY: israeli-bank-mcp reads credentials from environment variables and deliberately never from tool arguments, so they stay out of the model's conversation history. The env-var derivation (camelCase to UPPER_SNAKE, giving OTSAR_HAHAYAL_USERNAME) and the banks://list resource are now documented, because guessing a field name is how users end up pasting a password into a chat.

CORRECTED A MISLEADING CHARACTERISATION: both wrappers were described as pinning an old scraper. They declare caret ranges (^6.7.3 and ^6.1.4), which are floors; a fresh install resolves to the current release. What actually freezes a user is a committed lockfile or a stale Docker image, so the diagnostic instruction is to check the INSTALLED version, not the declared range.

FALSE POSITIVE AVOIDED, recorded so it is not re-raised: israeli-bank-mcp's README bank list omits Pagi. That is not a coverage gap. The server resolves banks through SCRAPERS[bankId] from the library rather than a hardcoded list, so it covers whatever the installed library covers. Reading the source rather than the README is what settled it.

SOURCING WITHDRAWAL: the BOI Access to Payment Systems page was cited for the bank identification codes and for an expansion from two to three digits by end-2026. Rendered in Playwright with location.href asserted, it is a landing page last updated 19/11/2023 with no identification-code list at all. The 3-digit claim is withdrawn and the code column is now marked unverified with an instruction never to build a payment instruction from it.

CARRY (re-logged, third cycle): per-bank transaction-history depth, session lifetimes, and the Berlin Group NextGenPSD2 characterisation of Israeli open banking are all still unsourced. This cycle stopped asserting them: each is now explicitly flagged unverified in both languages rather than stated as fact. Source or drop them next cycle.

CARRY (new, from the Expert): the skill is silent on Israeli transaction shapes a practitioner expects. israeli-bank-scrapers returns originalAmount and chargedAmount, and the script reads only amount, so a תשלומים instalment purchase is counted at the wrong figure. Also absent: pending vs completed status, originalCurrency, date vs processedDate (which decides which month a charge lands in), Bit and PayBox transfers, and the הוראת קבע recurring detection that Step 4 and Example 2 both promise and nothing implements. Step 5's VAT flagging and 'Israeli accounting software' export are promised with no format, no rate and no code.
CARRY (new): credential env vars in a shell profile or an MCP client JSON sit in plaintext on disk, and il-bank-mcp's SQLite file is an unencrypted full financial history at rest. Neither is said.

MY OWN FIX WAS WORSE THAN THE BUG, caught by the Expert on re-run. Having established that credits must not be netted (a salary is not a negative grocery bill), I then added a net_by_category view that netted exactly those credits, so a statement with a salary and any debit in the same category reported a large NEGATIVE category total, and both SKILL files told the agent to show it. Removed entirely: nothing in the data distinguishes a refund from a salary, so no automatic net figure is defensible. Log this shape: a fix that re-exposes the defect it just documented.

THE PREFIX FIX CREATED NEW COLLISIONS, also caught on re-run. Stripping all seven one-letter prefixes made de-prefixed fragments collide: הדלקה -> דלקה hit the fuel stem, בגט -> גט hit Gett, מבזק -> בזק, מקפה -> קפה, שגמל -> גמל. Narrowed to lamed only, which is the sole prefix the savings case actually needs (הפקדה לפנסיה, ניכוי לגמל), and added trailing Hebrew guards on the short stems דלק, גט, בזק and קפה. All five false positives now return Other and the savings fix still holds.

The docs were corrected to stop claiming the matching was solved, and then immediately asserted a closed list of exactly two remaining ambiguities, which was not true. Now stated as a CLASS of failure with the two named as common examples rather than as the complete set.

COVERAGE ADDED for the lines that dominate a real Israeli statement and all fell into Other: mortgage, loan, rent-in-words, account fees, Bituach Leumi, income tax, and gan/school/course. Housing had no mortgage rule at all while SKILL.md advertised Housing as rent, arnona and vaad bayit.

category_count was incremented for credits while by_category counted debits only, so any average-per-transaction an agent derived was wrong. The coerced numeric amount was also not written back into the emitted transactions, so a downstream consumer hit the very crash the coercion was added to prevent.

PROCESS: verify_legal.py flagged this skill REVIEW at level 3 on the word ניסוח in a sentence about Hebrew PHRASING, next to a pre-existing רואה חשבון in an example prompt. A pure false positive from ordinary prose. Reworded to צורת הכתיבה. Worth knowing that the drafting trigger fires on non-legal uses of the word.
